'''Shol Bestros''' was a [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miralukan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Shol Bestros was born several years before the beginning of the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] in [[3681 BBY]]. Unlike many of his [[Species/Legends|species]], Bestros turned his back on the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] until the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kao Cen Darach]] recognized the youth's power and convinced the young Miraluka to join the Order. Bestros was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the Order and eventually attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], becoming a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Bestros became acquainted with [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Gnost-Dural]] and seeing his interest in lore and knowledge, encouraged him to keep a [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|journal]].<ref name="The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural real-life book">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>

Following the Great Galactic War, Master Bestros returned to the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order and helped rebuild during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], residing at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] there. Hoping to construct a retreat on the [[Tythos Ridge]], all attempts were foiled when the native [[Flesh Raider]]s invaded the area and established a camp there.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Tythos Ridge}}</ref>
